entries.title: Close to the Sun

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no console emulation route is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 4 PC presentation with PC settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because it is the original high-fidelity release, later joined by Steam availability, with PC capture/settings flexibility and well-documented tweak options. Console, Switch, and Luna releases add access routes rather than exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Close to the Sun on Steam for Windows PC and check for FOV or ultrawide tweaks before capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or expanded edition is documented.
